projects.title: DevForge AI – AI Game Development Toolkit
projects.shortDescription: AI assistant for the Unity Editor: chat, code agent, scene and UI builders, optimizers and QA. Uses your own AI tool login (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor) – no API keys.
projects.description:
⚡ DevForge AI brings an AI development assistant, project analysis, and safe automated fixes into one Unity Editor window.

Describe what you want in plain language — a question about your code, a bug to fix, a scene to set up, or a complete feature. DevForge AI collects the relevant project context, asks the AI tool you already use, and shows every proposed change for your review before anything in your project is modified.

🔑 USE YOUR OWN AI — NO API KEYS

DevForge AI has no AI service or subscription of its own. It runs the official command-line tool of your provider with your own login:

• Claude Code (default)
• OpenAI Codex CLI
• Google Antigravity CLI (Gemini)
• Cursor CLI
• A local OpenAI-compatible model server (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio)

An account with at least one of these providers is required for AI features.

🧠 WHAT YOU CAN DO

• 💬 AI Chat with automatic project context — project information, scene, selection, Console, and project memory.
• 🏗️ Build from One Prompt — the AI creates a Development Plan covering systems, scripts, GameObjects, components, references, prefabs, and UI. After approval, agents implement it step by step, compile and verify, then provide a final report.
• 💻 Code Agent — plan → diff review → apply → compile check → AI error fixing, with rollback support.
• 🎬 Scene, GameObject, Prefab, UI & Animation Assistants — turn descriptions into reviewed editor operations with a single Undo step.
• 🤖 Agent Orchestrator — coordinate multi-step feature implementation.
• 🔍 Project Analyzers & Fixers — detect and fix missing scripts, lighting, textures, audio, models, materials, prefabs, UI, platform settings, and build settings.
• 🚀 Optimization Tools — performance, mobile, WebGL, graphics, memory, and build-size optimization.
• 🧪 Testing & QA — Console Fixer, Build Tools, Testing, and one-click Verify Project.
• 📖 Documentation Generator — generate documentation for game systems, API references, README files, and project architecture.

🛡️ SAFE BY DESIGN

• 👁️ Read-Only AI — the AI can read your project, if you allow it, but cannot directly write files or run commands.
• 🔎 Review Before Apply — every proposed change is shown first as a diff or operation list and is applied only after you confirm.
• 💾 Backups & Rollback — files, assets, and settings are backed up; scene edits support Unity Undo and one-click rollback.
• 📁 Controlled Writes — writes only inside Assets/. Likely secrets are removed from the context before sending.
• 🚫 No Telemetry — there is no DevForge server or telemetry. Data goes only to the AI provider you choose, and only after you accept the data notice.

👥 WHO IT'S FOR

• 🎮 Indie Developers & Solo Creators — use an AI assistant directly inside Unity without constantly switching between tools.
• 🏢 Small Studios & Teams — prototype faster with changes that can be reviewed and undone.
• 👨‍💻 Programmers — generate, fix, and refactor C#, resolve compile errors, and document project APIs.
• 🎨 Game & Level Designers — create GameObjects, scenes, and UI from descriptions, review the proposed operations, then apply them.
• 🧑‍🎨 Technical Artists — shader and material checks, Built-in to URP conversion, and texture, audio, and model import fixes.
• 🎓 Students & Unity Beginners — ask questions about their own project and get errors and code explained.
• 📱 Mobile & WebGL Teams — use optimization tools, build checks, and Verify Project before release.
• 🤖 AI Tool Users — anyone already using Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Google Gemini (Antigravity), Cursor, or a local AI model.

ℹ️ Note: DevForge AI is an Editor tool. It helps you build and maintain your game; it does not add AI features to the game at runtime.

📚 DOCUMENTATION

Includes:

• 📄 Illustrated PDF guide
• 📘 In-editor Product Guide explaining every feature
• 📝 Markdown documentation — User Guide, AI Providers, Privacy, Security, Compatibility, and Known Limitations

⚙️ REQUIREMENTS

• Unity 6 (6000.0) or newer
• 🖥️ Editor-only extension
• 📦 Nothing is added to your player builds

projects.title: Nine Men’s Morris (board game)
projects.shortDescription: Experience the classic Nine Men's Morris! Form a mill, capture opponent pieces, and claim victory! 🧠🎲
projects.description:
Dive into the ultimate strategic board game, Nine Men's Morris! Also known as Navakankari, Merels, or Mills, this timeless game challenges your logic and planning skills on a beautifully crafted digital wooden board.

Key Features:

🤖 Play vs Bot: Test your strategic skills against an intelligent AI.

👥 Play vs Friend: Enjoy local multiplayer (Pass & Play) with your friends and family.

🧑‍🎨 Custom Avatars & Profiles: Choose your favorite avatar from a unique collection and set your custom player name.

⚙️ Customizable Settings: Easily toggle Sound, Music, and Vibration for a personalized experience.

🏆 Earn Rewards: Win matches to collect in-game coins and track your progress!

How to Play:

Place: Take turns placing your pieces on the empty spots of the board.

Form a Mill: Align 3 of your pieces in a straight line to create a "Mill" (highlighted in green).

Capture: Every time you form a Mill, capture one of your opponent's pieces.

Win: Reduce your opponent to 2 pieces or block all their possible moves to win the match!

projects.title: ChronoScene - Scene History & Play Mode Keeper
projects.shortDescription: ⏪ Pressed Stop and lost the perfect jump height you tuned in Play Mode? 🗑️ Deleted an object yesterday and only noticed today?
projects.description:
⏪ Pressed Stop and lost the perfect jump height you tuned in Play Mode?
🗑️ Deleted an object yesterday and only noticed today?

ChronoScene keeps a timeline of your scenes, so you can see exactly what changed and when, and bring it back with one click.

🎮 Play Mode Keeper
When you stop Play Mode, ChronoScene lists every value that changed. Values you edited by hand in the Inspector are detected automatically and pre-selected. Click Keep Selected and they stay in your scene. Changes made by physics or scripts are listed separately, so they never sneak in.

📌 Keep Values After Play
Changed values with a script or an in-game debug menu? During Play, right-click any component and choose "ChronoScene: Keep Values After Play". When you stop, all its changed values are pre-selected.

🕒 Scene Timeline
Snapshots are taken automatically when you save, before Play and when Play ends. Take named checkpoints before risky changes and pin the ones that matter ⭐.

🔍 Changes View
Compare any snapshot with the current scene or with another snapshot:
✏️ Changed values, with before → after
➕ Added and ❌ deleted objects
🧩 Added and removed components
🔀 Renamed and moved objects
🔎 Search and filter by object or property

👻 Scene View Ghosts
See the snapshot right in the Scene view: an orange marker shows where a moved object used to be, with a dotted line to its current position. Deleted objects are marked with a red ✕ and new objects with a green +.

↩️ Selective Restore
Restore one value, a few rows, one object or the whole scene. Deleted objects come back, and prefab instances keep their prefab link. Every restore is a single Undo step, and a backup snapshot is taken first 🛡️.

📜 Object History
Right-click any GameObject to see every change it went through, and restore it to any point.

📋 Copy Report
Copy all visible changes as text with one click, ready for a teammate, a task or a commit message.

⚙️ Requirements & Details
✅ Unity 6000.0 or newer
🎨 Works with Built-in, URP and HDRP
🧰 Editor-only: no runtime code, nothing is added to your builds
📦 No dependencies, no internet connection, no data collection
💾 Snapshots are stored as compressed files in your project's UserSettings folder, which is not committed to version control by default
📖 Full C# source code and offline PDF documentation included

⚠️ Limitations
- References to objects that existed only in Play Mode (spawned clones, runtime material instances) cannot be restored.
- Arrays larger than 256 elements track only their size (configurable).
- Scenes only: prefabs edited in Prefab Mode are not snapshotted.
- Scene View Ghosts are not drawn for UI objects (RectTransform).

📩 Support: denish.makadiya@zohomail.com

changelog.notes:
🚀 1.0.0 – Initial release
📸 Scene snapshots: automatic on save, before Play and when Play ends, plus manual and named snapshots
🕒 Timeline with names, notes, pinning and automatic clean-up
🔍 Changes view: compare a snapshot with the current scene or another snapshot
↩️ Restore selected changes, one object or the whole scene in a single Undo step
🎮 Play Mode Keeper: keep values changed during Play Mode; values edited by hand are detected and pre-selected
📌 Keep Values After Play: mark a whole component during Play from its right-click menu

📋 Copy Report: copy the visible changes as text
🗜️ Compressed snapshot storage (gzip) to save disk space

3️⃣ Done! Write Indian text in any TextMeshPro text, in the Inspector or from code.

✨ FEATURES
✅ Correct conjuncts (क्ष त्र ज्ञ श्र), matras, reph, nukta, anusvara — in every script
✅ Fully automatic: no component to add, no code to write
✅ Runtime text changes: scores, names, dialogue, localisation
✅ Real Bold: <b>, Bold style and <font-weight> use the font's real weights (not fake bold)
✅ Exact mark positioning (OpenType GPOS) as designed by the font
✅ Mixed text: Indian + English + numbers + rich text tags
✅ Works with UI (TextMeshProUGUI) and 3D TextMeshPro
✅ Pure C#, no native plugins: Android, iOS, WebGL, Windows, macOS, Linux
✅ Playable Text Tester demo: paste any text, compare default TMP vs IndicTMP, copy the result

🌏 13 LANGUAGES · 9 SCRIPTS
Hindi · Marathi · Nepali · Sanskrit (Devanagari) · Gujarati · Bengali · Assamese · Punjabi (Gurmukhi) · Odia · Tamil · Telugu · Kannada · Malayalam

Verified against HarfBuzz (the text engine of Chrome and Android) on 271,729 words and conjunct combinations in all 9 scripts, Regular and Bold: 100% identical glyphs and positions.

scoreText.text = "स्कोर: " + score;   // shaped automatically

projects.title: VRX Optimizer – VR Comfort & Performance QA
projects.shortDescription: Find VR comfort and performance issues fast, see the evidence, and apply safe, reversible fixes.
projects.description:
🥽 VRX Optimizer — VR Comfort & Performance Toolkit for Unity
VRX Optimizer is a Unity Editor toolkit designed for VR developers and QA testers. It audits your project, captures comfort and performance signals during gameplay, explains findings with supporting evidence, and lets you apply fixes only after your approval.
🎯 MEASURE, EXPLAIN, THEN FIX
🔍 Project Audit

Inspect XR packages, URP settings (2D Renderer, MSAA, HDR, and Render Scale), Android/Quest build settings (IL2CPP, ARM64, ASTC, and Vulkan), scene complexity, cameras, shadows, and locomotion settings.

🛠️ Safe Fixes

Review current and proposed values, understand the reasoning and trade-offs, and approve changes before they are applied. Changes are validated, logged, and reversible.

📈 Runtime Sampler

Measure frame time, FPS, head and rig rotation, locomotion speed, acceleration, teleports, and snap turns. Measured overhead is approximately 12 µs per frame in the Editor.

🧠 Explainable Comfort Score

Evaluate seven documented rules using a visible scoring formula and data coverage. Missing measurements are explicitly marked as "Not Measured" rather than incorrectly classified as healthy.

📊 REVIEW, COMPARE, AND SHARE
📉 Timeline & Graphs

Explore performance and comfort signals alongside recorded events. Select a moment to inspect it in the Scene view.

🔄 Session Comparison

Compare two gameplay sessions to identify changes in measured signals.

📄 Offline Reports

Generate a self-contained HTML report and export additional reports in JSON and CSV formats.

♿ Accessibility Checklist

Review seated play, one-handed interaction, subtitles, flashing effects, and other accessibility considerations with your team.

🏗️ Build & CI Auditing

Audit every build scene or run project audits from the command line in your CI pipeline.

⚙️ DESIGNED FOR YOUR UNITY WORKFLOW
🎮 Unity Compatibility

Supports Unity 6.0 or newer, with no required external dependencies.

🥽 Flexible Rig Support

Reads the tracked camera and its parent transform. Optional XR Interaction Toolkit integration supports snap-turn, movement and turning speed, and vignette-related settings where available.

🔌 Custom Locomotion API

Integrate custom locomotion systems using VRXEvents.Teleport(), VRXEvents.SnapTurn(), and VRXEvents.Marker().

🧪 Included Demo Scene

Explore the toolkit's features without requiring a VR headset.

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST
Your data stays on your machine. VRX Optimizer makes no network calls and requires no accounts or analytics services.
⚠️ IMPORTANT INFORMATION
VRX Optimizer identifies potential comfort-risk indicators based on measured signals. It does not diagnose motion sickness or guarantee player comfort. Validate findings and performance on your target headsets and devices before release.
🚀 OPTIMIZE YOUR VR DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW
Audit your project, understand potential comfort risks, compare gameplay sessions, and make informed changes with VRX Optimizer.
Technical details
List the key features of your package







🎮 Unity Compatibility: Unity 6000.0+
🧩 Architecture: Unity Editor Tool + Optional Runtime Component
💻 Source Code: Full C# source code with GetSolveit.VRXOptimizer namespace and Assembly Definition Files (.asmdef)
🧪 Automated Testing: 22 EditMode Tests + 6 PlayMode Tests
📊 Report Exports: HTML, JSON (Versioned Schema 1.0.0), and CSV
⚙️ CI/CD Integration: Supports batch auditing via -executeMethod GetSolveit.VRXOptimizer.Editor.VRXBatchAudit.RunCI
📚 Offline Documentation: Complete user guide at Documentation/VRX_Optimizer_Guide.md
✅ Compatibility & Validation
🔧 Tested Environment: Unity 6000.3.9f1
🎨 Render Pipeline: Universal Render Pipeline (URP) 17.3
🖥️ Editor Platform: Windows
🥽 Headset Validation: Meta Quest and PCVR testing in progress
🚀 Built for Developers
Designed to integrate into professional Unity workflows, with automated testing, structured reporting, CI/CD support, and comprehensive offline documentation.
